subject: ghost

fault_definitions.subject: ghost
fault_definitions.business_rule: A column projection (fields=) must not change which posts a read returns: the posts listed by a projected read are the posts listed by the same read without the projection.
fault_definitions.description: Every 2xx GET /ghost/api/admin/posts/ response whose query string contains the key fields loses the member of $.posts with the smallest id; reads without fields are untouched (no trigger write).
fault_definitions.observable_effect: The dashboard read GET posts/?filter=status:published&fields=id,url,title,visibility,published_at&order=published_at desc&limit=5 (recorded 44x) comes back as {"posts":[],"meta":{...}} while GET posts/?filter=status:published&limit=1 (no fields, recorded 15x) still returns 'Coming soon'.

fault_definitions.subject: ghost
fault_definitions.business_rule: Asking for relation counts (include=count.active_members) must not change which newsletters a read returns: the newsletters listed with include are the newsletters listed without it.
fault_definitions.description: Every 2xx GET /ghost/api/admin/newsletters/ response whose query string contains the key include loses the last member of $.newsletters; reads without include (filter=status:active) are untouched (no trigger write).
fault_definitions.observable_effect: GET newsletters/?status=active&limit=100&include=count.active_members&page=1 (recorded 44x) and newsletters/?filter=status:active&include=none&limit=1 (5x) come back with an empty newsletters list, while GET newsletters/?filter=status:active (6x) still returns the default newsletter 'UISemTest-Ghost'.

fault_definitions.subject: ghost
fault_definitions.business_rule: An explicit sort order (order=) must not alter the members it sorts: a post reads back with the same title whether or not the read specifies order.
fault_definitions.description: Every 2xx GET /ghost/api/admin/posts/ response whose query string contains the key order has the fixed suffix ' [RQ2]' appended to the title of every post object; reads without order are untouched (no trigger write).
fault_definitions.observable_effect: The dashboard read (order=published_at desc, recorded 44x) and the post-list reads (order=published_at desc / updated_at desc) show 'Coming soon [RQ2]' while GET posts/?filter=status:published&limit=1 (no order) shows 'Coming soon'.

test_selection: qualified normal_pass on the isolated normal version; API-only read coverage, trigger uncertainty retained; RQ1 labels joined at reporting time
